structure.title: Fees when I need help
structure.description: At BitTasker, we believe in rewarding loyalty. The more tasks you complete, the less you pay in fees. Our dynamic tier system ensures that our most active customers enjoy the best rates.
structure.note: Save money as you use BitTasker! Our unique tier system rewards active customers with progressively lower fees.

rebooking.title: Rebooking Discount
rebooking.description: Love working with a particular worker? We reward repeat partnerships with significantly reduced fees!
rebooking.card_intro: When you rebook a worker you've worked with before within 30 days:
rebooking.example: Example: Rebooking a $100 task costs $101, whether you pay with Bitcoin, Lightning, or USDT.
rebooking.counts_toward_tier: Booking repeat work with a worker counts towards your 30 day rolling tasks to maintain your tier.

benefits.title: Customer Benefits & Visibility
benefits.description: Higher tier customers enjoy additional benefits beyond reduced fees:
benefits.badge: Badge Recognition: Earn prestigious tier badges displayed on your profile
benefits.priority: Priority Attention: Higher tier customers may receive more proposals from top workers
benefits.profile: Enhanced Profile: Your tier status signals to workers that you're an active and trusted customer

cta.title: Ready to hire workers with transparent pricing?

maintenance.title: Tier Advancement & Maintenance
maintenance.description: Your tier status is calculated based on your activity over the past 30 days, and is updated daily. The more tasks you complete, the higher your tier and the lower your fees.
